title: Neo4j Aura Instance
description: Schema for Neo4j AuraDB cloud database instances including configuration, status, and lifecycle management properties.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AuraDB instance

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the instance

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the tenant (project) this instance belongs to

cloud_provider.description: Cloud infrastructure provider hosting the instance

region.description: Cloud region where the instance is deployed

type.description: Instance type determining capabilities and pricing tier

connection_url.description: Bolt connection URI for connecting to the instance

metrics_integration_url.description: URL for the customer metrics integration endpoint

neo4j_version.description: Neo4j database version running on the instance

Tenant.description: A tenant (project) that organizes and manages multiple AuraDB instances under a single administrative unit.

instance_configurations.description: Available instance configurations for this tenant

InstanceConfiguration.description: An available instance configuration option within a tenant.

regions.description: Available cloud regions for this instance type

Snapshot.description: A point-in-time snapshot of an AuraDB instance for backup and restore purposes.

instance_id.description: Identifier of the instance this snapshot was taken from

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the snapshot was created

exportable.description: Whether the snapshot data can be exported
